name: Motosuwa Matsuri
source:
[b]An Unperfect Cool Beauty[/b]

A transfer student at Takumi's school.

Due to her love of Japanese culture and traditions, she came to Suminoe to attend the Mermaid Festival.

A cool beauty who loves the things that interest her, Matsuri is also someone who gets work done.

However, she's unexpectedly clumsy. She absolutely loves takoyaki.
